scope: The two supplied diff comments are fixed. A separate source-review finding remains open.

requested_fixes.change: Every captured read retains view.accepted with its write-graph snapshot. Child and preload contexts retain both owners.
requested_fixes.effect: Existing deferred-memory reservations survive the flush while a captured read still retains their batch.

requested_fixes.change: Preserve AtomPartition from core_filter through SecondaryPending.
requested_fixes.effect: The body fetch retains the selected physical atom location instead of relying only on the shared UUID locator.

limits: Both writes completed their flush before the following query captured an accepted batch.
The deferred-memory status field comes from a cached sampler. It cannot prove the exact release time.
Query replies omit atom creation time. The mutation routes discard source_file_name.
The initial attempt used an unavailable API metadata field. It is a driver setup failure, not a product regression.

remaining_findings.title: Keep unreserved durable writes out of captured graph snapshots
remaining_findings.problem: All accepted writes enter the graph, including forced-durable writes and memory-reservation fallback writes with no deferred reservation. Reads can retain those raw bodies after flush; current queue limits do not count old captured batches.
remaining_findings.evidence: Source review only. No direct ordinary API reproduction is claimed.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Publish unreserved durable requests at commit. Track hidden coordinates per queued request and pass them into commit_prepared_group so invalidation, key-domain updates, revision, and disk root change together. A guard around install_accepted alone is insufficient.
remaining_findings.status: open; distinct from retention of an existing reservation

benchmark_provenance: No new before/after timings. The prior benchmark report retains candidate-5 identity and receives a follow-up note.
